func surface(role: String, color: Color) -> StandardMaterial3D:
	var material := StandardMaterial3D.new()
	material.albedo_color = color
	var path := "res://assets/textures/" + role + ".png"
	if ResourceLoader.exists(path): material.albedo_texture = load(path)
	material.roughness = 0.83
	material.texture_filter = BaseMaterial3D.TEXTURE_FILTER_NEAREST_WITH_MIPMAPS
	return material

func floor_mesh(parent: Node3D, label: String, points: PackedVector2Array, y: float, material: Material, collision: bool = true) -> MeshInstance3D:
	var triangles := Geometry2D.triangulate_polygon(points)
	var st := SurfaceTool.new()
	st.begin(Mesh.PRIMITIVE_TRIANGLES)
	for n in range(0,triangles.size(),3):
		var a := Vector3(points[triangles[n]].x,y,points[triangles[n]].y)
		var b := Vector3(points[triangles[n+1]].x,y,points[triangles[n+1]].y)
		var c := Vector3(points[triangles[n+2]].x,y,points[triangles[n+2]].y)
		if (b-a).cross(c-a).y < 0.0:
			var swap := b; b = c; c = swap
		# Godot front faces use clockwise winding.
		for vertex in [a,c,b]:
			st.set_normal(Vector3.UP)
			st.set_uv(Vector2(vertex.x,vertex.z)*0.3)
			st.add_vertex(vertex)
	st.set_material(material)
	var instance := MeshInstance3D.new()
	instance.name = label
	instance.mesh = st.commit()
	parent.add_child(instance)
	if collision: instance.create_trimesh_collision()
	return instance

func beam(parent: Node3D, label: String, a: Vector3, b: Vector3, radius: float, material: Material) -> void:
	var mesh := CylinderMesh.new()
	mesh.top_radius = radius
	mesh.bottom_radius = radius
	mesh.height = a.distance_to(b)
	mesh.radial_segments = 8
	mesh.rings = 1
	var instance := MeshInstance3D.new()
	instance.name = label
	instance.mesh = mesh
	instance.material_override = material
	parent.add_child(instance)
	instance.position = (a+b)*0.5
	var direction := (b-a).normalized()
	var right := direction.cross(Vector3.FORWARD)
	if right.length_squared() < 0.01: right = direction.cross(Vector3.RIGHT)
	right = right.normalized()
	instance.basis = Basis(right,direction,right.cross(direction)).orthonormalized()

func model(parent: Node3D, file: String, label: String, location: Vector3, yaw: float = 0.0) -> Node3D:
	var wrapper := Node3D.new()
	wrapper.name = label
	wrapper.set_meta("catalogue_file",file)
	parent.add_child(wrapper)
	wrapper.position = location
	wrapper.rotation.y = yaw
	var visual := (load("res://assets/models/"+file) as PackedScene).instantiate()
	wrapper.add_child(visual)
	if file == "AST-ATR-001.glb":
		# D02 now has a level garden floor; its former drop-edge guard is superseded.
		for part in visual.find_children("D02_*","MeshInstance3D",true,false):
			part.visible = false
	if file == "AST-ARC-001.glb":
		# The continuous fitted network owns this edge; keep the source floor/soffit.
		for part in visual.find_children("*","MeshInstance3D",true,false):
			if part.name.begins_with("ARC_Guard") or part.name.begins_with("ARC_Handrail") or part.name.begins_with("ARC_Continuous") or part.name.begins_with("ARC_Glass") or part.name.begins_with("ARC_Post") or part.name in ["ARC_ProfiledFascia","ARC_LowerShadowReveal"]:
				part.visible = false
	if not file.begins_with("AST-BOT"):
		_static_contacts(visual)
	return wrapper

	var structure := Node3D.new()

func apply_light_profile(light: Light3D, profile_name: String) -> void:
	var profiles: Dictionary = JSON.parse_string(FileAccess.get_file_as_string("res://data/lighting_profiles.json"))
	var profile: Dictionary = profiles[profile_name]
	light.light_color = Color(profile.color[0],profile.color[1],profile.color[2])
	light.light_energy = profile.energy
	if light is OmniLight3D: light.omni_range = profile.range_m
	elif light is SpotLight3D: light.spot_range = profile.range_m
	light.shadow_enabled = profile.shadows

func set_display_effects(enabled: bool) -> void:
	var environment: Environment = $WorldEnvironment.environment
	environment.glow_enabled = enabled
	environment.ssao_enabled = enabled

func _static_contacts(node: Node) -> void:
	if node is MeshInstance3D and node.mesh != null and node.visible and not node.name.begins_with("ALC_VisualFloor"):
		load("res://scripts/static_contact_cache.gd").attach(node)
	for child in node.get_children():
		if not child is StaticBody3D: _static_contacts(child)

func express_arrive(deck_index: int) -> bool:
	if deck_index < 0 or deck_index >= deck_y.size(): return false
	if deck_index==17:return arrive_at(Vector3(0,deck_y[deck_index]+0.1,-77),0.0)
	return arrive_at(Vector3(5.5,deck_y[deck_index]+0.1,-72),0.0)

func arrive_at(arrival: Vector3, facing_y: float) -> bool:
	var player: CharacterBody3D = $ShipSpace/PersistentActors/Player
	var state := get_world_3d().direct_space_state
	var query := PhysicsRayQueryParameters3D.create(arrival+Vector3.UP,arrival-Vector3.UP*2)
	query.exclude = [player.get_rid()]
	var hit := state.intersect_ray(query)
	if hit.is_empty() or hit.normal.y < 0.7: return false
	if absf(hit.position.y-(arrival.y-0.1)) > 0.15: return false
	var capsule := CapsuleShape3D.new()
	capsule.radius = 0.3
	capsule.height = 1.8
	var clearance := PhysicsShapeQueryParameters3D.new()
	clearance.shape = capsule
	clearance.transform.origin = arrival+Vector3.UP*0.9
	clearance.exclude = [player.get_rid()]
	if not state.intersect_shape(clearance).is_empty(): return false
	player.position = arrival
	player.spawn_position = arrival
	player.velocity = Vector3.ZERO
	player.rotation.y = facing_y
	return true

func surface(role: String, color: Color) -> StandardMaterial3D:
	var material := StandardMaterial3D.new()
	material.albedo_color = color
	var path := "res://assets/textures/" + role + ".png"
	if ResourceLoader.exists(path): material.albedo_texture = load(path)
	material.roughness = 0.83
	material.texture_filter = BaseMaterial3D.TEXTURE_FILTER_NEAREST_WITH_MIPMAPS
	return material

func floor_mesh(parent: Node3D, label: String, points: PackedVector2Array, y: float, material: Material, collision: bool = true) -> MeshInstance3D:
	var triangles := Geometry2D.triangulate_polygon(points)
	var st := SurfaceTool.new()
	st.begin(Mesh.PRIMITIVE_TRIANGLES)
	for n in range(0,triangles.size(),3):
		var a := Vector3(points[triangles[n]].x,y,points[triangles[n]].y)
		var b := Vector3(points[triangles[n+1]].x,y,points[triangles[n+1]].y)
		var c := Vector3(points[triangles[n+2]].x,y,points[triangles[n+2]].y)
		if (b-a).cross(c-a).y < 0.0:
			var swap := b; b = c; c = swap
		# Godot front faces use clockwise winding.
		for vertex in [a,c,b]:
			st.set_normal(Vector3.UP)
			st.set_uv(Vector2(vertex.x,vertex.z)*0.3)
			st.add_vertex(vertex)
	st.set_material(material)
	var instance := MeshInstance3D.new()
	instance.name = label
	instance.mesh = st.commit()
	parent.add_child(instance)
	if collision: instance.create_trimesh_collision()
	return instance

func beam(parent: Node3D, label: String, a: Vector3, b: Vector3, radius: float, material: Material) -> void:
	var mesh := CylinderMesh.new()
	mesh.top_radius = radius
	mesh.bottom_radius = radius
	mesh.height = a.distance_to(b)
	mesh.radial_segments = 8
	mesh.rings = 1
	var instance := MeshInstance3D.new()
	instance.name = label
	instance.mesh = mesh
	instance.material_override = material
	parent.add_child(instance)
	instance.position = (a+b)*0.5
	var direction := (b-a).normalized()
	var right := direction.cross(Vector3.FORWARD)
	if right.length_squared() < 0.01: right = direction.cross(Vector3.RIGHT)
	right = right.normalized()
	instance.basis = Basis(right,direction,right.cross(direction)).orthonormalized()

func model(parent: Node3D, file: String, label: String, location: Vector3, yaw: float = 0.0) -> Node3D:
	var wrapper := Node3D.new()
	wrapper.name = label
	wrapper.set_meta("catalogue_file",file)
	parent.add_child(wrapper)
	wrapper.position = location
	wrapper.rotation.y = yaw
	var visual := (load("res://assets/models/"+file) as PackedScene).instantiate()
	wrapper.add_child(visual)
	if file == "AST-ATR-001.glb":
		# D02 now has a level garden floor; its former drop-edge guard is superseded.
		for part in visual.find_children("D02_*","MeshInstance3D",true,false):
			part.visible = false
	if file == "AST-ARC-001.glb":
		# The continuous fitted network owns this edge; keep the source floor/soffit.
		for part in visual.find_children("*","MeshInstance3D",true,false):
			if part.name.begins_with("ARC_Guard") or part.name.begins_with("ARC_Handrail") or part.name.begins_with("ARC_Continuous") or part.name.begins_with("ARC_Glass") or part.name.begins_with("ARC_Post") or part.name in ["ARC_ProfiledFascia","ARC_LowerShadowReveal"]:
				part.visible = false
	if not file.begins_with("AST-BOT"):
		_static_contacts(visual)
	return wrapper

func build_structural_datums() -> void:
	var structure := Node3D.new()
	structure.name = "All18DeckStructuralDatums_NOT_FINISHED_ARCHITECTURE"
	$ShipSpace.add_child(structure)

func arrive_at(arrival: Vector3, facing_y: float) -> bool:
	var residency:=get_node_or_null("ShipSystems/ReceivedRoomResidency")
	if residency!=null:residency.prepare_position(arrival)
	var player: CharacterBody3D = $ShipSpace/PersistentActors/Player
	var state := get_world_3d().direct_space_state
	var query := PhysicsRayQueryParameters3D.create(arrival+Vector3.UP,arrival-Vector3.UP*2)
	query.exclude = [player.get_rid()]
	var hit := state.intersect_ray(query)
	if hit.is_empty() or hit.normal.y < 0.7: return false
	if absf(hit.position.y-(arrival.y-0.1)) > 0.15: return false
	var capsule := CapsuleShape3D.new()
	capsule.radius = 0.3
	capsule.height = 1.8
	var clearance := PhysicsShapeQueryParameters3D.new()
	clearance.shape = capsule
	clearance.transform.origin = arrival+Vector3.UP*0.9
	clearance.exclude = [player.get_rid()]
	if not state.intersect_shape(clearance).is_empty(): return false
	player.position = arrival
	player.spawn_position = arrival
	player.velocity = Vector3.ZERO
	player.rotation.y = facing_y
	return true

extends Node3D
# Single moving physics cabin with independently positioned gates. Dynamic
# passengers and loose objects are never reparented to the moving platform.
var floor_heights:Array[float]=[84.0,88.5]
var deck_numbers:Array[int]=[13,14]
# Optional local destinations share a deck without inventing extra ship decks.
var stop_ids:Array[String]=[]
var stop_names:Array[String]=[]
var stop_codes:Array[String]=[]
var gate_origin_xz:=Vector2(92.2,0)
var identity_prefix:="commons"
var district_label:="Commons"
var cabin_file:="AST-CIR-003.glb"
var persistent_id:StringName=&"starboard_commons_lift_001"
var cabin:AnimatableBody3D
var cabin_gate:Node3D
var landing_gates:Array[Node3D]=[]
var current_floor:=0
var destination_floor:=0
var queued_floor:=-1
var phase:="opening"
var travel_velocity:=0.0
var maximum_speed:=1.1
var acceleration:=.65
var button_script=preload("res://scripts/lift_button.gd")
func _stop_id(index:int) -> String:
	return stop_ids[index] if not stop_ids.is_empty() else "D"+str(deck_numbers[index])
func _ready() -> void:
	assert(floor_heights.size() in [2,3,5,17,18] and deck_numbers.size()==floor_heights.size(),"Use an authored two-, three-, five-, seventeen- or eighteen-stop cabin panel")
	assert(stop_ids.is_empty() or (stop_ids.size()==floor_heights.size() and stop_names.size()==floor_heights.size() and stop_codes.size()==floor_heights.size()))
	var identities:Dictionary={}
	for i in range(floor_heights.size()):
		assert(not identities.has(_stop_id(i)),"Lift destinations require distinct persistent identities")
		identities[_stop_id(i)]=true
	for i in range(1,floor_heights.size()):assert(floor_heights[i]>floor_heights[i-1])
	process_physics_priority=-20
	for i in range(floor_heights.size()):
		var gate:Node3D=load("res://scripts/lift_gate.gd").new()
		gate.name="LandingGate_"+_stop_id(i)
		gate.persistent_id=StringName(_stop_id(i)+"_"+identity_prefix+"_lift_gate")
		gate.position=Vector3(gate_origin_xz.x-.12,floor_heights[i],gate_origin_xz.y)
		gate.rotation.y=PI/2
		add_child(gate)
		landing_gates.append(gate)
		_button(self,Vector3(gate_origin_xz.x-.34,floor_heights[i]+1.3,gate_origin_xz.y+1.65),i,_stop_id(i)+"_"+identity_prefix+"_lift_call")
		_box(self,Vector3(gate_origin_xz.x-.055,floor_heights[i]-.055,gate_origin_xz.y),Vector3(.09,.11,2.4),"FixedSill_"+_stop_id(i))
	cabin=AnimatableBody3D.new()
	cabin.name="Moving"+district_label+"Cabin"
	cabin.set_meta("persistent_id",identity_prefix+"_lift_cabin_001")
	cabin.sync_to_physics=false
	cabin.position=Vector3(gate_origin_xz.x,floor_heights[0],gate_origin_xz.y)
	cabin.rotation.y=-PI/2
	add_child(cabin)
	var visual:Node3D=(load("res://assets/models/"+cabin_file)as PackedScene).instantiate()
	visual.set_meta("catalogue_file",cabin_file)
	cabin.add_child(visual)
	# Simple convex platform follows the actual faceted platform perimeter.
	var points:=PackedVector3Array()
	for y in [-.18,0.0]:
		for p in [Vector2(-2,0),Vector2(2,0),Vector2(2,3.25),Vector2(1.65,3.6),Vector2(-1.65,3.6),Vector2(-2,3.25)]:points.append(Vector3(p.x,y,-p.y))
	var contact:=CollisionShape3D.new()
	var floor_shape:=ConvexPolygonShape3D.new()
	floor_shape.points=points
	floor_shape.margin=.001
	contact.shape=floor_shape
	cabin.add_child(contact)
	for side in [-1,1]:
		_box(cabin,Vector3(side*1.94,1.4,-1.695),Vector3(.12,2.8,3.11),"CabinSide")
		_box(cabin,Vector3(side*1.65,.245,-2.875),Vector3(.5,.49,.55),"CabinSeat")
		var corner_points:=PackedVector3Array()
		for h in [0.0,2.8]:
			for p in [Vector2(side*2,3.25),Vector2(side*1.65,3.6),Vector2(side*1.60,3.47),Vector2(side*1.88,3.19)]:corner_points.append(Vector3(p.x,h,-p.y))
		var corner_contact:=CollisionShape3D.new()
		var corner_shape:=ConvexPolygonShape3D.new()
		corner_shape.points=corner_points
		corner_shape.margin=.001
		corner_contact.shape=corner_shape
		cabin.add_child(corner_contact)
		# Actual pocket skins, not a solid box across moving leaf travel.
		_box(cabin,Vector3(side*1.55,1.325,-.205),Vector3(.70,2.65,.020),"CabinGateFrontSkin")
		_box(cabin,Vector3(side*1.55,1.325,-.0475),Vector3(.70,2.65,.025),"CabinGateBackSkin")
		_box(cabin,Vector3(side*1.89,1.405,-.125),Vector3(.02,2.81,.18),"CabinGatePocketEnd")
	_box(cabin,Vector3(0,2.75,-.125),Vector3(3.84,.20,.20),"CabinGateHeader")
	_box(cabin,Vector3(0,1.4,-3.535),Vector3(3.3,2.8,.13),"CabinRear")
	_box(cabin,Vector3(0,2.87,-1.8),Vector3(4,.14,3.6),"CabinRoof")
	# Match the actual authored control backing, not only the distant cabin wall.
	if floor_heights.size()==2:
		_box(cabin,Vector3(1.815,1.265,-.69),Vector3(.13,.57,.38),"CabinControlBacking")
	elif floor_heights.size() in [17,18]:
		_box(cabin,Vector3(1.815,1.35,-.98),Vector3(.13,1.50,1.28),"CabinControlBacking")
	elif floor_heights.size()==5:
		_box(cabin,Vector3(1.815,1.33,-1.02),Vector3(.13,.46,1.40),"CabinControlBacking")
	else:
		_box(cabin,Vector3(1.815,1.33,-.84),Vector3(.13,.46,.82),"CabinControlBacking")
	for i in range(floor_heights.size()):
		var marker:=visual.find_child("DATUM_floor_button_"+str(i),true,false)as Node3D
		assert(marker!=null,"Cabin panel lacks a physical floor-control datum")
		_button(cabin,marker.position,i,identity_prefix+"_cabin_"+_stop_id(i))
	for side in [-1,1]:
		var marker:=visual.find_child("DATUM_light_"+str(side),true,false)as Node3D
		var light:=SpotLight3D.new()
		cabin.add_child(light)
		light.position=marker.position
		light.rotation.x=-PI/2
		light.spot_angle=70
		light.spot_range=4
		light.light_energy=.7
		light.shadow_enabled=true
		light.light_color=Color(1,.95,.87)
	cabin_gate=load("res://scripts/lift_gate.gd").new()
	cabin_gate.name="CabinGate"
	cabin_gate.persistent_id=StringName(identity_prefix+"_cabin_gate")
	cabin_gate.position=Vector3(gate_origin_xz.x+.12,floor_heights[0],gate_origin_xz.y)
	cabin_gate.rotation.y=PI/2
	add_child(cabin_gate)
	# Cabin-gate fixed-frame contacts must move with the cabin as well.
	# Disable the frame's static contacts; body-owned fitted side walls protect it.
	for node in cabin_gate.find_children("StaticContact","StaticBody3D",true,false):node.queue_free()
	cabin.sync_to_physics=true
	_set_present()
func _box(parent:Node3D,pos:Vector3,size:Vector3,label:String) -> void:
	var contact:=CollisionShape3D.new()
	contact.name=label
	var shape:=BoxShape3D.new()
	shape.size=size
	shape.margin=.001
	contact.shape=shape
	contact.position=pos
	if parent is CollisionObject3D:parent.add_child(contact)
	else:
		var body:=StaticBody3D.new()
		parent.add_child(body)
		body.add_child(contact)
func _button(parent:Node3D,pos:Vector3,index:int,identity:String) -> void:
	var button:Node3D=button_script.new()
	button.controller=self
	button.floor_index=index
	button.display_deck=deck_numbers[index]
	if not stop_ids.is_empty():
		button.destination_name=stop_names[index]
		button.face_code=stop_codes[index]
	button.district_label=district_label
	button.persistent_id=StringName(identity)
	button.name=identity
	button.position=pos
	button.rotation.y=-PI/2
	parent.add_child(button)
func request_floor(index:int) -> bool:
	if index<0 or index>=floor_heights.size():return false
	if phase=="moving":
		queued_floor=index
		return true
	destination_floor=index
	if index==current_floor:
		phase="opening"
		_set_present()
	else:
		phase="closing"
		cabin_gate.request_close()
		for gate in landing_gates:gate.request_close()
	return true
func _set_present() -> void:
	cabin_gate.cabin_present_and_stopped=true
	cabin_gate.request_open()
	for i in range(floor_heights.size()):
		landing_gates[i].cabin_present_and_stopped=(i==current_floor)
		if i==current_floor:landing_gates[i].request_open()
		else:landing_gates[i].request_close()
func _physics_process(delta:float) -> void:
	if phase=="opening":
		if cabin_gate.open_fraction>.999 and landing_gates[current_floor].open_fraction>.999:
			phase="idle"
			if queued_floor>=0:
				var next:=queued_floor
				queued_floor=-1
				request_floor(next)
	elif phase=="closing":
		if not cabin_gate.is_closed_and_clear():return
		for gate in landing_gates:
			if not gate.is_closed_and_clear():return
		cabin_gate.cabin_present_and_stopped=false
		for gate in landing_gates:gate.cabin_present_and_stopped=false
		phase="moving"
	elif phase=="moving":
		var remaining:float=floor_heights[destination_floor]-cabin.position.y
		var wanted:float=sign(remaining)*min(maximum_speed,sqrt(2*acceleration*abs(remaining)))
		travel_velocity=move_toward(travel_velocity,wanted,acceleration*delta)
		if abs(remaining)<=abs(travel_velocity*delta)+.0001:
			cabin.position.y=floor_heights[destination_floor]
			travel_velocity=0
			current_floor=destination_floor
			phase="opening"
			_set_present()
		else:cabin.position.y+=travel_velocity*delta
		cabin_gate.position.y=cabin.position.y

extends RefCounted
static func build(parent:Node3D,ship:Node3D) -> void:
	var district:=Node3D.new()
	district.name="D12_D14_StarAtlas_WIP"
	district.set_meta("programme_keys",["D12_directory_05","D13_directory_04","D14_directory_03"])
	district.set_meta("historical_library_id","D12_stargazing4")
	parent.add_child(district)
	var architecture:Node3D=ship.model(district,"AST-LIB-011.glb","StarAtlasAuthoredArchitecture",Vector3(-80,78,0))
	var glass:=ShaderMaterial.new()
	glass.shader=load("res://shaders/hospitality_glass.gdshader")
	for part in architecture.find_children("*","MeshInstance3D",true,false):
		if "glass" in part.name:part.material_override=glass
		if part.name.begins_with("LIB_steps") or part.name.begins_with("LIB_finish"):
			var contact:=part.get_node_or_null("StaticContact")
			if contact!=null:contact.free()
	# Closed source-authored stair wedges provide the single smooth walking contact.
	var lift:Node3D=load("res://scripts/commons_lift.gd").new()
	lift.name="StarAtlasPassengerLift"
	lift.floor_heights.assign([78.0,84.0,88.5])
	lift.deck_numbers.assign([12,13,14])
	lift.gate_origin_xz=Vector2(-68.2,-10.2)
	lift.identity_prefix="star_atlas"
	lift.district_label="Star Atlas"
	lift.cabin_file="AST-CIR-003_three_stop.glb"
	lift.persistent_id=&"star_atlas_lift_001"
	district.add_child(lift)
	for i in range(10):
		var marker:=architecture.find_child("DATUM_light_"+str(i),true,false)as Node3D
		assert(marker!=null)
		var light:=SpotLight3D.new()
		district.add_child(light)
		light.name="StarAtlasSource_"+str(i)
		light.global_position=marker.global_position
		light.rotation.x=-PI/2
		light.spot_angle=67
		light.spot_range=22 if i==5 else 10
		light.light_energy=2.1 if i==5 else 1.3
		light.light_color=Color(1,.95,.87)
		light.shadow_enabled=true

	load("res://scripts/star_atlas_collections.gd").build(district,ship)

	load("res://scripts/star_atlas_commons.gd").build(district,ship)

	load("res://scripts/star_atlas_arrival.gd").build(district,ship)

func _resize() -> void:
	var screen := Vector2(get_viewport().size)
	var logical := Vector2(world_view.size)
	var scale_factor := minf(screen.x / logical.x, screen.y / logical.y)
	if scale_factor >= 1.0:
		scale_factor = maxf(1.0, floorf(scale_factor))
	display.size = logical * scale_factor
	display.position = (screen - display.size) * 0.5

func _unhandled_input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
	if directory_open and event is InputEventKey and event.pressed and event.keycode == KEY_ESCAPE:
		_toggle_directory()
		return
	if event is InputEventKey and event.pressed and not event.echo and event.keycode == KEY_M:
		_toggle_directory()
	if event is InputEventKey and event.pressed and not event.echo and event.keycode == KEY_F3:
		set_world_resolution((resolution_index+1)%RESOLUTIONS.size())
	if event is InputEventKey and event.pressed and not event.echo and event.keycode == KEY_F11:
		get_window().mode = Window.MODE_WINDOWED if get_window().mode == Window.MODE_FULLSCREEN else Window.MODE_FULLSCREEN
	if event is InputEventKey and event.pressed and event.keycode == KEY_F12:
		_capture()
	if event is InputEventKey and event.pressed and event.keycode == KEY_F4:
		effects = not effects
		post_pass.material.set_shader_parameter("effects_enabled", effects)
		world_view.get_node("Astraea").set_display_effects(effects)

	var world = world_view.get_node("Astraea")
	if world.arrive_at(arrival,facing):
		get_node("NativeResolutionStatus").text = "ASTRAEA / "+label+"\nWASD · Mouse · RMB focus · M directory · F4 effects\nProduction architecture in progress"

func _process(_delta: float) -> void:
	if not is_instance_valid(reticle): return

	var actor = world_view.get_node_or_null("Astraea/ShipSpace/PersistentActors/Player")

	assert(index >= 0 and index < RESOLUTIONS.size())

func _resize() -> void:
	var screen := Vector2(get_viewport().size)
	var logical := Vector2(world_view.size)
	var scale_factor := minf(screen.x / logical.x, screen.y / logical.y)
	if scale_factor >= 1.0:
		scale_factor = maxf(1.0, floorf(scale_factor))
	display.size = logical * scale_factor
	display.position = (screen - display.size) * 0.5

func _unhandled_input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
	if directory_open and event is InputEventKey and event.pressed and event.keycode == KEY_ESCAPE:
		_toggle_directory()
		return
	if event is InputEventKey and event.pressed and not event.echo and event.keycode == KEY_M:
		_toggle_directory()
	if event is InputEventKey and event.pressed and not event.echo and event.keycode == KEY_F3:
		set_world_resolution((resolution_index+1)%RESOLUTIONS.size())
	if event is InputEventKey and event.pressed and not event.echo and event.keycode == KEY_F11:
		get_window().mode = Window.MODE_WINDOWED if get_window().mode == Window.MODE_FULLSCREEN else Window.MODE_FULLSCREEN
	if event is InputEventKey and event.pressed and event.keycode == KEY_F12:
		_capture()
	if event is InputEventKey and event.pressed and event.keycode == KEY_F4:
		effects = not effects
		post_pass.material.set_shader_parameter("effects_enabled", effects)
		world_view.get_node("Astraea").set_display_effects(effects)
